data.description: A nereid's shawl (hardness 2, hp 6) contains a portion of her life force.  If the shawl is ever destroyed, the nereid takes 1d6 points of Constitution drain per hour until she dies.  A nereid can craft a new shawl from water by making a DC 25 Will save, but each attempt takes 1d4 hours to complete.  Attempts to destroy or steal a nereid's shawl require the sunder or disarm attempts.
